title: Kassapo (2)
text: 1. Sāvatthiyaṃ ārāme || || 2. Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Kassapo devaputto Bhagavato santike {imaṃ} gātham abhāsi || || Bhikkhu siyā jhāyī vimuttacitto || ākaṅkhe ca hadayassānuppattiṃ || lokassa ñatvā udayabbayañca || sucetaso asito tadānisaṃso ti || || [page 047] II. 1. 2.] PAṬHAMO-VAGGA 1. 47
